name: kids-science-video
description: 儿童科普动画（Remotion + three.js）：汽油车 / 电动车系列

scripts.check: tsc --noEmit && tsx scripts/check-scene.ts && tsx scripts/check-scene-ev.ts && tsx scripts/audit-ev.ts && python3 scripts/check_glyphs.py
scripts.render:narrated: npm run audio && remotion render GasCarVoice out/gas-car_narrated.mp4
scripts.render:subtitles: npm run audio && remotion render GasCarSubtitles out/gas-car_subtitles-only.mp4
scripts.wmv: bash scripts/to-wmv.sh out/gas-car_narrated.mp4 out/gas-car_subtitles-only.mp4 out/electric-car_narrated.mp4 out/electric-car_subtitles-only.mp4
scripts.render:ev-narrated: npm run audio && remotion render ElectricCarVoice out/electric-car_narrated.mp4
scripts.render:ev-subtitles: npm run audio && remotion render ElectricCarSubtitles out/electric-car_subtitles-only.mp4
